Options: 
A. 7.2 kilometers per liter

G. 4.16 kilometers per liter
H. 2.2 kilometers per liter
I. 9.4 kilometers per liter
J. 5.3 kilometers per liter

Provide the correct letter choice in \boxed{X}, where X is the correct letter choice. Keep the explanation or feedback within 3 sentences.
